note: Semantic concept registry: ~30 REAL capital concepts, every binding points at a live engine or a printed/seeded JSON source on this VPS. No filler concepts. Resolution rule: rank bindings by quality x freshness, fetch best, fall through to next on failure. Verification vocabulary (inline on every observation): VERIFIED_LIVE | VERIFIED_SINGLE | UNVERIFIED | STALE (as_of/collected_at > 30 days). If the source declares its own verification field, it is inherited.

concepts.title: Brent crude spot price

bindings.verification_policy: live: VERIFIED_LIVE if ticker.stale is false and observed_at within 30d; STALE if stale flag or old observed_at; inherit source stale field
